instruction_problem: Second answer: 'could' is correct (Even with my glasses on, I could hardly read: past reading of the same situation, no time frame given). 'can't' also works (can't hardly is non-standard; 'can't' alone loses 'hardly' so not valid). Give a past or present cue.

instruction_problem: 'is' is also possible as a literary/present narration, but 'could' makes past; 'was' is the only natural one. Gap gives answer away via 'Such' inversion only mildly.
American spelling 'realize' is also correct; accept both. 'Only when' at the start gives the inversion away.
'had waited' is also correct with 'for over an hour'. Task needs one extra cue (e.g. 'still') to force continuous.

instruction_problem: 'should have' (BrE) is correct; 'has' is also acceptable informally (indicative), less formal-subjunctive. Giving '(have)' hands over the subjunctive form.

answer: I'd rather you wouldn't have sold the car.
